#  Title:Twisted heterotic/type I duality
Authors:[Kevin Costello](https://arxiv.org/search/hep-th?searchtype=author&query=Costello,+K), [Brian R. Williams](https://arxiv.org/search/hep-th?searchtype=author&query=Williams,+B+R)
View a PDF of the paper titled Twisted heterotic/type I duality, by Kevin Costello and Brian R. Williams
[View PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2110.14616) [HTML (experimental)](https://arxiv.org/html/2110.14616v1)
> Abstract:We formulate a twisted version of the conjectured duality between heterotic and type I string theories. Our formulation relates the chiral part of the heterotic string with a type I topological B-model on a Calabi-Yau five-fold. We provide a non-trivial check of this duality by showing that certain infinite-dimensional Lie algebras of global gauge transformations built from each theory are isomorphic. Matching the structure constants of the Lie algebras involves a detailed analysis of one-loop corrections on the type I side.
